# R.P. Lumber

> > R.P. Lumber is a comprehensive building materials and hardware supplier serving professional contractors and DIYers with lumber, tools, design services, and home improvement products.

R.P. Lumber offers a full range of building materials including TimberTech composite decking, professional-grade tools from Milwaukee and DeWalt, and hardware from trusted brands like Moen, Valspar, and Rust-Oleum. The company provides specialized services for contractors including job-site delivery, kitchen and bath design, and estimating services, while rewarding all customers through the My R.P. Rewards loyalty program.

## Key Topics

- Building materials and lumber supply
- Professional contractor services
- Milwaukee and DeWalt power tools
- TimberTech composite decking
- My R.P. Rewards loyalty program
- Hardware and home improvement supplies
- Job-site delivery services
- Kitchen and bath design
- Estimating services
- Moen plumbing fixtures
- Valspar and Rust-Oleum paints
- Seasonal maintenance products
- Veterans rewards program
- Monthly promotional circulars
